extension.summary: Switch this install between the Echo config sets: 4K surround, 1080p stereo, 4K stereo
extension.description: Pick a config set and it is applied to this install: audio output and passthrough (through Kodi's own settings), and the quality caps and filters of POV, Gears, Otaku, The Chains, Ghost, WatchNixtoons2 and Mad Titan Sports. 4K_7CH_4K: 7.1 / passthrough to a receiver, 4K, HDR and Dolby Vision allowed. 4K_2CH_1080: stereo, no passthrough, 1080p cap, no HDR / Dolby Vision / AV1. 4K_2CH_4K: stereo, no passthrough, 4K and everything on. A surround device that this PC does not have is skipped, not forced. Settings are backed up first (userdata/profile_backups); Kodi should be restarted afterwards so every add-on re-reads its settings. No service, nothing runs in the background.
extension.news: 1.0.1: audio switching works (1.0.0 called two JSON-RPC methods Kodi 22 does not have); reads back what Kodi kept, logs every step to kodi.log. 1.0.0: first version, same engine as tools/profile_builder.py.
